profile.summary: I have been developing web applications since 2019, specializing in Angular and TypeScript, with a focus on Signals and Standalone Components. I have worked as a developer and team lead on fintech projects and cloud platforms, covering architecture, development, code quality, and collaboration with clients and stakeholders. I use Cursor, Antigravity, Copilot, Claude Code, and OpenCode in my daily workflow, along with custom skills and MCP servers for code generation, refactoring, and documentation that fit the project's architecture.

orbyta.role: Senior IT Consultant - Frontend & Application Architecture
orbyta.description: Frontend consulting for modern web applications. I work with Angular, Signals, RxJS, NgRx, PrimeNG, Tailwind and Bootstrap, define architecture with the client, and manage priorities and delivery. I integrate Java backends and real-time features through STOMP. I also use Cursor, OpenCode, MCP servers and custom skills for code writing, review and refactoring.

scai.description: Led the frontend team developing a debt recovery management application with a Micro-Frontend architecture. I worked with Angular, RxJS, PrimeNG and Bootstrap and added Cypress end-to-end tests for key flows, reducing regression risk during releases. I also handled technical mentoring, code review and alignment with business goals in an Agile environment.

acca.description: Developed the Angular and RxJS frontend of usBIM.com, a Kanban application for workflow management, using Angular Material and DevExpress. Integrated REST APIs with Node.js and Express.js, built real-time features with Socket.IO, and worked with MySQL for persistence in an Agile environment.
